extDescription: Your new tab as an interactive graph of bookmarks: folders, tags and the tabs you already have open.
hint: click opens (or switches to the tab if already open) · ⌘click new tab · right-click edits and tags · º: only open · type to search
tabCountTitle: Open tabs matching bookmarks · click or press º to show only the open ones
sessionsTitle: Save and restore sets of windows (with tab groups)
emptyNoBookmarksBody: Import bookmarks from chrome://bookmarks and they will show up here as a graph.
emptyNoOpenBody: No open tab matches your bookmarks. Press º or the ⧉ button to see everything.
emptyNoHistoryBody: Try widening the time range from the ◷ selector.
tooltipGoToTab: click: go to the open tab
tooltipOpenSubgraph: $1 bookmarks · click to open the subgraph
badgeOnlyOpen: ⧉ only open ($1) — press º to see all
badgeNoTabsPermission: ⧉ no tab access — the «tabs» permission is missing
badgeHiddenUrls: ⧉ Chrome is hiding URLs — accept the «tabs» permission in chrome://extensions
tourWelcomeTitle: Your new tab is a map
tourWelcomeBody: This is a sample graph to show you Graphacker without touching your data. Every circle is a bookmark; every color blob, a folder.
tourClustersBody: Each folder is a cluster with its own color. We just zoomed into one: its bookmarks orbit around it, sized by usage.
tourSearchBody: Type from anywhere or press /. We just searched for “docs”: the graph dims everything that doesn't match. It also searches by #tag.
tourTagsBody: The same bookmarks, another topology: grouped by tags. The switch is live — physics repositions every node.
tourDomainsBody: Automatic grouping by domain, with subdomains and paths as levels. Nothing to maintain: it derives itself.
tourHistoryBody: Your recent browsing as a graph: time ranges, sessions and arrows showing the real transitions between pages.
tourMenuBody: Every node has a context menu: rename, tag, move, delete, colors… This is a folder's. On the background: create and tweak.
tourOpenTabsBody: Ring and satellites: this bookmark has tabs open right now. Click to jump to the tab; particles flow toward what's open.
tourOnlyOpenBody: The º filter prunes the graph to your current browsing session: your tabs projected onto your bookmarks.
tourListBody: The same data without canvas: accessible, clickable, grouped by cluster.
tourSessionsBody: Save your open windows under a name and restore them whenever you need, groups included.
tourPrivacyBody: Bookmarks, history and tabs never leave Chrome. If you ever share something, it will always be an explicit action.
tourGesturesBody: click opens · ⌘click new tab · right-click edits · drag pins the layout · / searches · º open only. You can revisit this guide by right-clicking the background.
historyClearFilter: Clear the custom range (back to the last 24 hours)
historyUnsavedTitle: Only pages without a bookmark — click to filter the triage
toastDomainMuted: Domain muted: $1 — manage it from the ◷ menu
dlgTagFolderNote: Adds the tags to the $1 bookmarks in the folder (without removing existing ones).
dlgDeleteTagNote: It will be removed from every bookmark. The bookmarks themselves are not touched.
dlgDeleteFolderNote: The folder and its $1 bookmarks will be deleted.
dlgSaveSessionNote: Saves which tabs are in each window, their order, which are pinned, the groups (title, colour, collapsed) and the position and size of each window.
dlgSaveSessionNoGroups: ⚠ The «tabGroups» permission is NOT active right now: groups would be saved without title or colour.
diagOnlyInExtension: Diagnostics only make sense inside the extension
toastPreviewNoSave: Preview: changes are not saved to Chrome
toastPreviewGoToTab: Preview: would switch to the tab «$1»
toastPreviewRestore: Preview: would open $1 window(s) with $2 tabs
toastTagsSeeded: Starter tags generated — right-click › Tags to edit them
toastUnpinAll: All nodes released — physics is rearranging the view
toastNoTabsToSave: There are no tabs to save in that scope
toastTabError: Could not switch to the tab: $1
toastPermissionGranted: Permission granted — open a new tab to finish activating it
toastMissingPermissions: ⚠ Permissions not applied: $1 — disable and re-enable Graphacker in chrome://extensions
toastNoTabGroups: Tab groups are saved without name or colour: the «tabGroups» permission is missing
toastSessionLocalOnly: Session saved on this device only (could not sync: $1)
toastSessionNoGroupMeta: — without the «tabGroups» permission groups will be restored with no title or colour
toastSessionRestoredSplit: Session «$1» restored — Chrome does not let extensions recreate split view; the pair is left selected: right-click the selection → «split view»
hygClean: All clean: no duplicates, empty folders or invisible bookmarks.
hygDuplicates: Duplicates ($1 groups) — copies that would be removed
hygInvisible: Invisible in the graph ($1) — non-http(s) URLs, e.g. bookmarklets
toastImportInvalid: The file is not a Graphacker export
settingsOpenModeHint: Where Graphacker shows up when you open a new tab.
settingsActionModeHint: What happens when you click the extension icon in the toolbar.
settingsShortcutsHint: The browser assigns the key combinations; here you can see the current ones.
settingsSyncHint: Which data travels between the browsers where you're signed in.
settingsOpenModeActionDesc: New tabs show the browser's own page; open Graphacker with its toolbar icon (pin it to keep it handy).
settingsActionModeAutoDesc: If the graph takes over the new tab, the button saves the current page; if you keep your own new tab, the button opens the graph.
settingsActionModeCaptureDesc: Opens a panel to save the tab with a suggested folder and tags. The graph stays one right-click away on the icon, or via its keyboard shortcut.
settingsActionModeGraphDesc: Clicking goes straight to the graph. Saving the current page stays one right-click away on the icon, or via its keyboard shortcut.
shortcutsUnavailable: Keyboard shortcuts only exist inside the extension.
settingsSyncDesc: Tags and sessions travel across your Chrome/Firefox via synced storage. Turn it off to keep everything on this device only.
settingsSyncUnavailable: Synced storage is not available in this browser.
